title: Thai-Style Pork Kebabs
description: Tender pork marinated in a blend of Thai flavors and grilled to perfection. Serve with your favorite sides for a delicious and easy meal.

ingredients.name: pork shoulder, cut into 1-inch pieces
ingredients.notes: You can also use pork loin or pork belly

instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together brown sugar, fish sauce, lime juice, olive oil, garlic, ginger, kecap manis, and chili flakes.
2. Add the pork pieces to the marinade and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
3. Preheat your grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
4. Thread the marinated pork onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
5. Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until the pork is cooked through and slightly charred.
6. Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve with your favorite sides, such as steamed rice or stir-fried vegetables.
7. Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
